topics.prompt: Create a meta-learning algorithm that learns a policy initialization enabling rapid adaptation to new robotic manipulation tasks with only five demonstrations, and benchmark on the Meta-World benchmark.

topics.name: Adversarial Robustness via Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) on CIFAR-10
topics.prompt: Let's design a PGD-based adversarial training pipeline for a ResNet on CIFAR-10, focusing on epsilon selection and loss function tuning.

topics.name: Federated Averaging with Differential Privacy on Mobile Health Data
topics.prompt: Can we implement Federated Averaging across mobile health devices, adding DP noise to gradients, and evaluate utility vs privacy trade-offs?

topics.name: Graph Attention Networks for Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
topics.prompt: Let's build a Graph Attention Network to predict protein-protein interactions from biological graphs, optimizing attention heads and node features.

topics.name: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) for Few-Shot Text Classification
topics.prompt: Let's apply MAML to a transformer-based text classifier for few-shot sentiment tasks, exploring inner-loop learning rates and batch sizes.

topics.name: Causal Bayesian Networks for Counterfactual Recommendation Systems
topics.prompt: Can we construct a causal Bayesian network to model user-item interactions and compute counterfactual recommendations, comparing with standard collaborative filtering?

topics.name: Federated Learning with Differential Privacy for Healthcare Data
topics.prompt: Let's build a federated learning pipeline that trains a disease risk model across hospitals while preserving patient privacy using DP-SGD.

topics.name: Optimal Transport-based Domain Adaptation for Satellite Imagery
topics.prompt: Let's implement a domain adaptation framework that aligns source and target satellite image distributions via Sinkhorn divergence for land cover classification.

topics.name: Neural Architecture Search for Time Series Forecasting
topics.prompt: Let's apply differentiable NAS to discover an efficient LSTM-based architecture for high-frequency trading price prediction.

topics.name: Adversarial Robustness in Transformer-based NLP Models
topics.prompt: Let's evaluate and improve the robustness of a BERT model against text-based adversarial attacks using gradient-based perturbations.

topics.name: Adversarial Training for Robustness in Deep Neural Networks
topics.prompt: Let's design and implement a robust image classification system using adversarial training with FGSM and PGD attacks on ResNet-50, measuring robustness against unseen attacks.

topics.name: Variational Autoencoders for Anomaly Detection in Time Series
topics.prompt: Let's implement a VAE that learns latent representations of multivariate sensor data and flags anomalies when reconstruction error exceeds a learned threshold.

topics.name: Bayesian Optimization with Gaussian Processes for Hyperparameter Tuning
topics.prompt: Let's apply Bayesian optimization using a GP surrogate to tune hyperparameters of a Transformer model for language modeling, aiming to reduce perplexity by at least 5%.

topics.name: Adversarial Training for Image Classification: FGSM and PGD Attacks
topics.prompt: Can you explain how to implement Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) and Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) attacks on a deep neural network, and how to use them for adversarial training?

topics.name: Spectral Clustering for Graph Data: Normalized Cut and Laplacian Eigenmaps
topics.prompt: Let's discuss how to apply normalized cut and Laplacian eigenmaps for spectral clustering on a graph dataset, including the choice of kernel and parameter selection.

topics.name: Attention Mechanism in Transformers: Scaled Dot-Product and Multi-Head Attention
topics.prompt: Can you describe the scaled dot-product attention and multi-head attention mechanisms used in transformers, and provide an example of how to implement them in PyTorch?

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks: Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) and Graph Attention Network (GAT)
topics.prompt: Let's discuss the architecture and implementation of Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) and Graph Attention Network (GAT) for graph classification and regression tasks.

topics.name: Information-Theoretic Learning: Mutual Information and Wasserstein Autoencoder
topics.prompt: Can you explain how to use mutual information and Wasserstein autoencoder for information-theoretic learning, and provide an example of how to apply them to a real-world problem?

topics.name: Adversarial Robustness in Convolutional Neural Networks via Fast Gradient Method
topics.prompt: Explain the process of crafting adversarial examples for a pre-trained CNN using the Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) and discuss its limitations.

topics.name: Solving the Wasserstein GAN Problem using the Lagrange Multiplier Method
topics.prompt: Derive the Lagrange multiplier method for solving the minimax problem in Wasserstein GANs and provide a Python implementation.

topics.name: Optimizing the k-Means++ Algorithm for Large-Scale Clustering
topics.prompt: Discuss the k-Means++ algorithm for initializing cluster centers and propose a parallelized version using MapReduce for large-scale clustering.

topics.name: TensorFlow Implementation of the Variational Autoencoder for Dimensionality Reduction
topics.prompt: Implement a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) using TensorFlow for dimensionality reduction on the MNIST dataset and evaluate its performance.

topics.name: Analyzing the Bias-Variance Tradeoff in Regularized Logistic Regression
topics.prompt: Derive the bias-variance tradeoff for regularized logistic regression and analyze its impact on model performance using the L1 and L2 regularization methods.

topics.name: Training Autoencoders for Anomaly Detection in Time Series Data
topics.prompt: How would you design a variational autoencoder to detect anomalies in stock prices using a sequence of daily returns?

topics.name: Implementing the Wasserstein GAN for Image-to-Image Translation Tasks
topics.prompt: Can you explain how to modify the WGAN loss function to stabilize the training of a CycleGAN for translating daytime images to nighttime images?

topics.name: Mathematical Formulation of Contrastive Loss for Few-Shot Learning
topics.prompt: Derive the mathematical formulation of the InfoNCE loss function for training a Siamese network for few-shot image classification tasks

topics.name: Designing a Convolutional Neural Network for 3D Object Detection in LiDAR Point Clouds
topics.prompt: How would you modify the PointNet architecture to detect and classify 3D objects in LiDAR point clouds, and what are the key considerations for training such a model?

topics.name: Applying the Concept of Explainability to LIME for Model Interpretability
topics.prompt: Can you explain how to use LIME to interpret the predictions of a logistic regression model, and what are the limitations of this approach?

topics.name: Bayesian Optimization for Hyperparameter Tuning: Expected Improvement vs. Probability of Improvement
topics.prompt: Let's implement a Bayesian optimization pipeline to tune a Transformer-based model's learning rate and batch size using GPyOpt or BoTorch. Compare the Expected Improvement (EI) and Probability of Improvement (PI) acquisition functions on a synthetic benchmark (e.g., Rosenbrock function) and a real-world dataset like CIFAR-10. How does the choice of acquisition function impact convergence speed and final validation accuracy?

topics.name: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning: MoCo v3 vs. SimCLR with Vision Transformers
topics.prompt: Implement MoCo v3 and SimCLR for ViT-Small on ImageNet-100 using PyTorch Lightning. Modify the queue size, temperature parameter, and projection head architecture. Evaluate the linear probing accuracy after self-supervised pretraining and compare the performance with supervised fine-tuning. How does the momentum encoder in MoCo v3 affect the quality of learned representations compared to SimCLR's purely end-to-end approach?

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks for Drug Discovery: Message Passing vs. Attention Mechanisms in Molecule Property Prediction
topics.prompt: Design a GNN pipeline to predict molecular properties (e.g., solubility or binding affinity) using the MoleculeNet dataset. Compare a message-passing neural network (MPNN) with a graph attention network (GAT) and a graph transformer (GT). Use RDKit for featurization and PyG for implementation. How does the attention mechanism in GT improve interpretability and performance over MPNN and GAT?

topics.name: Differentiable Neural Architecture Search (DNAS): Gradient-Based Optimization of Cell Topologies in EfficientNet
topics.prompt: Implement a differentiable NAS pipeline to optimize the cell structure of a lightweight CNN for CIFAR-10, similar to DARTS but with continuous relaxation. Use gradient descent to jointly optimize architecture parameters and weights. Compare the search runtime and final model performance against a manually designed EfficientNet-B0. How does the choice of operation space (e.g., separable convolutions, dilated convolutions) impact the discovered architecture?

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning for Portfolio Optimization: PPO vs. SAC with Transaction Costs and Market Regime Switching
topics.prompt: Build a reinforcement learning agent to manage a financial portfolio using the Yahoo Finance API or a synthetic dataset. Implement PPO and SAC with a custom reward function that penalizes transaction costs and accounts for market regime shifts (e.g., bull vs. bear markets). Compare the cumulative returns and Sharpe ratios of the two algorithms. How does the inclusion of a market regime classifier (e.g., using an LSTM) improve the agent's performance?

topics.name: Bayesian Optimization for Hyperparameter Tuning: Acquisition Functions and Multi-Fidelity Methods
topics.prompt: Let's implement a Bayesian optimization pipeline from scratch using GPyOpt or BoTorch, but replace the default expected improvement acquisition with a custom Thompson Sampling-based approach. How would we modify the acquisition function to handle noisy evaluations and integrate it with a multi-fidelity strategy like Hyperband? Let's compare convergence rates on a neural architecture search task for CIFAR-10.

topics.name: Transformer-Based Time Series Forecasting: Temporal Fusion Transformers (TFT) with Interpretability Constraints
topics.prompt: Let's design a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) from scratch for multivariate time series forecasting, but add a custom attention masking mechanism to enforce domain-specific constraints (e.g., disallowing attention between unrelated features). Train it on the Electricity Load Forecasting dataset and evaluate feature importance using the built-in interpretable components. How would we quantify the trade-off between forecast accuracy and interpretability?

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks for Drug Discovery: Message Passing with 3D Molecular Graphs
topics.prompt: Let's build a Graph Neural Network (GNN) that operates on 3D molecular graphs (nodes = atoms, edges = bonds + spatial distances) to predict binding affinities. Implement a custom message-passing layer that incorporates both bond-based and distance-based interactions, then train it on the PDBBind dataset. How would we handle the lack of labeled data for rare interactions? Let's compare against ECFP featurization.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning for Robot Control: Offline-to-Online Policy Transfer with Conservative Q-Learning
topics.prompt: Let's train a Sawyer robot to perform door-opening tasks using conservative Q-learning (CQL) on a pre-collected offline dataset, then fine-tune it online with minimal real-world interactions. How would we design the reward function to avoid local optima (e.g., jittering)? Let's implement a dual-clipping mechanism to stabilize training and compare against standard DDPG. Use PyBullet or Mujoco for simulation.

topics.name: Self-Supervised Learning for Medical Imaging: Contrastive Learning with Domain-Specific Augmentations
topics.prompt: Let's pre-train a ResNet-50 on the CheXpert dataset using SimCLR but replace the standard augmentations (e.g., random crops) with domain-specific ones (e.g., synthetic lung lesion insertion, contrast enhancement). How would we design a custom contrastive loss that accounts for anatomical symmetry (e.g., left/right lungs)? Evaluate downstream performance on pneumonia detection and compare against supervised pretraining.

topics.name: Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization with Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE)
topics.prompt: How would you implement a Bayesian optimization pipeline using TPE for tuning a Transformer-based model's learning rate and dropout rate, given a noisy validation loss metric? Explain how the surrogate model and acquisition function interact to balance exploration and exploitation.

topics.name: Differentiable Neural Architecture Search (DARTS) with Second-Order Unrolling
topics.prompt: Walk through the mathematical formulation of DARTS' bi-level optimization problem. Implement the second-order approximation to compute the Hessian term efficiently for a small CNN on CIFAR-10. How does this approximation impact the final architecture selection?

topics.name: Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA) for Robust Neural Network Generalization
topics.prompt: Derive the SWA update rule and explain its connection to the posterior distribution over weights in a Bayesian neural network. Implement SWA for a ResNet-50 trained on ImageNet and compare its performance to standard SGD in terms of calibration and out-of-distribution robustness.

topics.name: Monte Carlo Dropout for Uncertainty Estimation in Medical Image Segmentation
topics.prompt: Implement a U-Net with Monte Carlo dropout at test time for segmenting MRI brain tumors. Formulate the predictive entropy and mutual information metrics to quantify aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. How would you use these metrics to reject low-confidence predictions during deployment?

topics.name: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning via SimCLR with Memory-Efficient Gradient Accumulation
topics.prompt: Explain the SimCLR loss function's dependence on positive and negative sample pairs. Implement it using gradient accumulation to handle large batch sizes on a single GPU. Modify the projection head architecture to reduce dimensional collapse. How does the temperature parameter affect the learned representations?

topics.name: Implicit Neural Representations for 3D Reconstruction: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and Variants
topics.prompt: Let's implement a simplified NeRF from scratch to reconstruct a 3D object from 2D images. Start by formulating the volume rendering equation, then derive the positional encoding trick to handle high-frequency details. After implementing the MLP, train it on a synthetic dataset and evaluate the PSNR metric. Finally, compare it with a baseline NeRF implementation using PyTorch.

topics.name: Adversarial Training for Robust Deep Learning: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) and TRADES Loss Optimization
topics.prompt: Let's design an adversarial training pipeline for a ResNet-50 classifier on CIFAR-10 using PGD attacks. First, implement the PGD attack with configurable perturbation budgets (L2 and Linf norms). Then, train the model using the TRADES loss function, which balances standard and adversarial training objectives. Finally, evaluate robustness via AutoAttack and compare against AT (Adversarial Training) and standard training baselines.

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction: Message Passing with Attention (AttentiveFP) and Graphormer
topics.prompt: Let's implement AttentiveFP, a GNN architecture for molecular property prediction, from scratch. Start by defining the molecular graph featurization (atom and bond features). Then, implement the message-passing mechanism with GRU-based updates and node-level attention. Train the model on the BACE dataset and compare its performance with Graphormer, a transformer-based GNN. Analyze the attention weights to interpret chemical substructures.

topics.name: Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS) with Second-Order Approximations and Gradient-Based Optimization
topics.prompt: Let's implement DARTS, a gradient-based neural architecture search (NAS) method, without relying on third-party libraries. Begin by defining the continuous relaxation of the architecture search space using softmax over operations. Then, compute the second-order approximation of the bilevel optimization problem (train vs. validation loss) and implement gradient descent for both the weights and architecture parameters. Finally, evaluate the discovered architecture on CIFAR-10 and compare it with random search and ENAS.

topics.name: Self-Supervised Learning for Time-Series: Contrastive Learning with TS-TCC and Masked Reconstruction Pretext Tasks
topics.prompt: Let's implement a self-supervised learning pipeline for time-series data using TS-TCC (Temporal Shift Contrasting) and masked reconstruction. Start by defining the contrastive loss (e.g., NT-Xent) and temporal shift augmentation strategies. Then, implement a transformer-based encoder and pretext tasks for both contrastive learning and masked reconstruction. Pretrain the model on the UCR Time Series Archive and fine-tune it for downstream classification tasks. Compare the results with supervised baselines.

topics.name: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning with SwAV on Large-Scale Image Datasets
topics.prompt: Let's pretext-task implementation of SwAV (Swapping Assignments between Views) for unsupervised feature learning on the ImageNet-1K dataset. How does the queue-based dictionary update mechanism compare to MoCo's momentum encoder in terms of memory efficiency and representation quality?

topics.name: Differentiable Neural Architecture Search (DARTS) with Gradient-Based Optimization
topics.prompt: Let's implement DARTS to search for optimal cell structures in a convolutional neural network (CNN) on the Penn Treebank dataset. How does the bi-level optimization (train vs. validation loss) affect the stability of the architecture search? Compare softmax vs. Gumbel-Softmax for categorical sampling.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in Continuous Action Spaces
topics.prompt: Let's train a PPO agent to solve the MuJoCo HalfCheetah-v4 environment. How does the clipping range (ε) hyperparameter affect policy updates and sample efficiency? Compare the performance of Gaussian vs. Tanh-squashed action distributions in terms of exploration and stability.

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Graph Attention Networks (GAT) for Molecular Property Prediction
topics.prompt: Let's implement a GAT model to predict solubility (ESOL) and quantum mechanical properties (QM9) using the MoleculeNet benchmark. How does multi-head attention (number of heads) impact the model's ability to capture long-range dependencies in molecular graphs? Compare GAT with GraphSAGE for inductive vs. transductive learning.

topics.name: Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization via Expected Improvement Acquisition Function
topics.prompt: Let's implement the Expected Improvement (EI) acquisition function for Bayesian Optimization from scratch, including the Gaussian Process surrogate model and the Matern 5/2 kernel. How would you modify the acquisition function to handle noisy evaluations with a known noise variance σ²? Walk me through the gradient computation for EI to derive the optimal next query point.

topics.name: Self-Supervised Learning with Contrastive Loss on Multi-Modal Data (Audio + Text)
topics.prompt: Let's design a contrastive learning framework where audio embeddings (from a pre-trained Wav2Vec 2.0 model) and text embeddings (from a fine-tuned BERT model) are projected into a shared latent space. How would you adapt the InfoNCE loss to account for the temporal alignment between audio and text? Implement the temperature scaling mechanism and explain its impact on the loss landscape.

topics.name: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) for Efficient Transformer Variants with FLOPs Constraints
topics.prompt: Let's optimize a transformer architecture under strict FLOPs constraints (e.g., ≤ 10 GFLOPs) for sequence lengths up to 8192 tokens. How would you modify the search space to include grouped-query attention (GQA) and sliding window attention (SWA)? Implement a differentiable NAS framework using Gumbel-Softmax relaxation and derive the gradient updates for the architecture parameters.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning with Conservative Q-Learning (CQL) for Offline-to-Online Transfer
topics.prompt: Let's extend CQL to handle offline reinforcement learning followed by online fine-tuning. How would you modify the conservative penalty term to account for distributional shift when transitioning from offline data (e.g., D4RL datasets) to online interaction? Implement the dual Q-network trick and explain how it mitigates overestimation bias in the offline phase.

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks with Spectral Attention for Molecular Property Prediction
topics.prompt: Let's design a GNN that combines spectral graph theory (e.g., Laplacian eigenvectors) with attention mechanisms to predict molecular properties (e.g., solubility or toxicity). How would you encode the molecular graph into a fixed-size representation while preserving geometric invariances? Implement the spectral attention layer and derive the backpropagation through the eigendecomposition step.

topics.name: Bayesian Optimization with Thompson Sampling for Hyperparameter Tuning
topics.prompt: Let's implement a Thompson Sampling-based Bayesian Optimization algorithm to tune hyperparameters for a Transformer model. We'll derive the posterior update equations for Gaussian Process priors and compare it against grid search and random search on the WikiText-103 perplexity optimization task. Show me how to handle non-stationary reward landscapes in this setup.

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks with Spectral Attention for Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
topics.prompt: Let's design a Graph Neural Network with spectral attention mechanisms to predict drug-drug interactions from heterogeneous biomedical graphs. We'll implement the ChebNetII spectral filters and contrast them with standard GCN and GAT layers. Use the DrugBank dataset and evaluate on AUC-ROC with a focus on explainability via attention weights.

topics.name: Differential Equation Guided Neural Networks (Neural ODEs) for Time-Series Forecasting
topics.prompt: Let's build a Neural ODE model for irregularly sampled time-series data where the dynamics are governed by SDEs with learnable drift and diffusion terms. We'll implement the adjoint sensitivity method for gradient computation and compare against LSTM and Transformer baselines on the PhysioNet sepsis prediction dataset. Focus on stability guarantees for long-horizon predictions.

topics.name: Contrastive Learning with Hard Negative Mining for Self-Supervised Vision Tasks
topics.prompt: Let's implement a SimCLR variant with hard negative mining where negatives are selected based on feature space density and semantic similarity. We'll use the MoCo framework with a momentum encoder and evaluate on ImageNet-1K with linear probing. Derive the theoretical bounds on the InfoNCE loss when using hard negatives.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning with Conservative Q-Learning (CQL) for Offline Policy Evaluation
topics.prompt: Let's implement CQL for offline reinforcement learning where we learn a conservative estimate of the Q-function to avoid overestimation bias. We'll use the D4RL benchmark with the HalfCheetah-v2 environment and compare against BCQ and TD3+BC. Derive the dual formulation of the CQL objective and analyze its convergence properties.

topics.name: Bayesian Optimization for Hyperparameter Tuning: Advanced Acquisition Functions and Multi-Armed Bandits
topics.prompt: Let's implement a Bayesian Optimization framework from scratch for tuning a Transformer-based model's hyperparameters (e.g., learning rate, dropout, attention heads) using the Expected Improvement (EI) and Thompson Sampling acquisition functions. How would we modify the acquisition function to handle noisy evaluations in a distributed training setup with GPUs? Discuss the trade-offs between UCB (Upper Confidence Bound) and EI in terms of convergence speed and sample efficiency.

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for Fraud Detection: Message Passing and Anomaly Score Aggregation
topics.prompt: Design a GNN architecture for detecting fraudulent transactions in a dynamic graph where nodes represent users and edges represent transactions. Implement a custom message-passing mechanism that incorporates temporal features (e.g., transaction time, frequency) and anomaly scores. How would you aggregate node-level predictions to detect fraud rings (i.e., subgraphs of colluding users)? Compare the performance of GraphSAGE, GAT, and a custom attention-based aggregator.

topics.name: Differential Privacy in Federated Learning: Secure Aggregation and Gradient Clipping
topics.prompt: Implement a federated learning system with differential privacy guarantees using the Rényi Differential Privacy (RDP) framework. How would you extend the DP-FedAvg algorithm to include secure aggregation (e.g., using homomorphic encryption) to prevent server-side privacy leaks? Discuss the impact of gradient clipping thresholds and noise scales on model utility and convergence for a real-world dataset like EMNIST.

topics.name: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) with Reinforcement Learning: Policy Gradient Optimization and Weight Sharing
topics.prompt: Build a NAS framework using Reinforcement Learning where the agent is trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to discover optimal CNN architectures for CIFAR-10. Implement weight sharing between child models to reduce computational overhead. How would you modify the reward function to balance accuracy and latency on edge devices? Compare the performance of PPO with Evolutionary Algorithms (e.g., NSGA-II) for multi-objective NAS.

topics.name: Causal Inference with Deep Structural Causal Models (DSCMs): Counterfactual Data Generation and Potential Outcomes
topics.prompt: Implement a Deep Structural Causal Model (DSCM) to estimate counterfactual outcomes in a healthcare dataset (e.g., the effect of a drug on patient recovery). Use a neural network to model the structural equations and train it with a combination of observational data and synthetic counterfactual samples. How would you validate the model's counterfactual predictions using a held-out test set of randomized controlled trials (RCTs)? Discuss the limitations of DSCMs when dealing with unobserved confounders.

topics.name: Self-Supervised Learning: Contrastive Learning with SimCLR and MoCo in Vision Transformers
topics.prompt: Let's implement a SimCLR-style contrastive learning pipeline using a Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone, then compare it with MoCo's momentum encoder approach. How do we handle augmentations, temperature scaling, and negative sampling in distributed training? Can we visualize the learned feature space with UMAP?

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks: Message Passing with Adaptive Node Embeddings and Graph Attention Variants
topics.prompt: Let's derive the mathematical formulation of Graph Attention Networks (GAT) with adaptive node embeddings, then extend it to a sparse transformer-based GNN. How do we implement multi-head attention with sparse adjacency matrices? Can we compare performance on ogbn-arxiv versus a standard GCN?

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning: Off-Policy Actor-Critic with Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3) and State-Action Entropy Regularization
topics.prompt: Let's implement TD3 from scratch, then add state-action entropy regularization to encourage exploration. How do we stabilize the target policy smoothing and delayed updates? Can we benchmark this on continuous control tasks like Mujoco Ant-v4 vs. standard DDPG?

topics.name: Neural Architecture Search (NAS): Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS) with Second-Order Gradient Approximations
topics.prompt: Let's implement DARTS with PyTorch, focusing on the bilevel optimization problem and second-order gradient approximations. How do we handle memory constraints when computing Hessian-vector products? Can we compare the learned cell architectures on CIFAR-10 versus random search?

topics.name: Probabilistic Deep Learning: Variational Autoencoders with Normalizing Flows for Complex Likelihood Modeling
topics.prompt: Let's implement a VAE with a normalizing flow prior (e.g., RealNVP) and compare it to a standard Gaussian prior. How do we compute the log-likelihood gradient efficiently? Can we evaluate the model on MNIST with and without flows using bits per dimension?

topics.name: Bayesian Optimization for Hyperparameter Tuning: Acquisition Functions and Surrogate Models
topics.prompt: Let's implement a Bayesian Optimization framework from scratch to tune hyperparameters for a neural network. How would you choose between Expected Improvement (EI), Probability of Improvement (PI), or Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) as acquisition functions? Derive the mathematical formulation for UCB and discuss its bias-variance tradeoff in high-dimensional spaces. Implement the surrogate model using Gaussian Processes (GPs) with Matérn kernels and compare its performance against Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) on the CIFAR-10 dataset.

topics.name: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for Molecular Property Prediction: Message Passing and Graph Attention Mechanisms
topics.prompt: Design a GNN architecture to predict molecular properties (e.g., toxicity or solubility) using the MoleculeNet dataset. Implement a custom message-passing layer with edge features and compare the performance of Graph Attention Networks (GAT) against Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) in terms of interpretability and accuracy. Derive the attention mechanism's softmax operation over neighbors and discuss how to handle varying graph sizes. Use PyTorch Geometric and evaluate on the ESOL dataset with RMSE as the metric.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning for Trading: Deep Q-Learning with Portfolio Optimization Constraints
topics.prompt: Develop a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent to trade stocks in a simulated environment with transaction costs and portfolio constraints. Implement a custom reward function that accounts for Sharpe ratio maximization and discuss the challenges of credit assignment in multi-asset trading. Use a replay buffer with prioritized experience replay (PER) and compare its performance against Double DQN. Train the agent on historical S&P 500 data and evaluate using cumulative returns and maximum drawdown.

topics.name: Adversarial Machine Learning: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) with Spectral Normalization and Self-Supervised Learning
topics.prompt: Train a GAN with spectral normalization on the CelebA dataset to generate high-resolution images. Implement the discriminator with self-supervised learning by adding an auxiliary rotation prediction task. Derive the gradient penalty term in the WGAN-GP formulation and discuss its role in stabilizing training. Compare the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) scores of your model against a baseline DCGAN and analyze mode collapse using t-SNE plots of latent space embeddings.

topics.name: Causal Inference in Machine Learning: Propensity Score Matching and Double Machine Learning for Treatment Effect Estimation
topics.prompt: Implement a causal inference pipeline to estimate the average treatment effect (ATE) of a marketing campaign using propensity score matching (PSM) and Double Machine Learning (DML). Derive the doubly robust estimator and discuss its properties under model misspecification. Use logistic regression for propensity score estimation and a gradient-boosted tree for the outcome model. Evaluate the results on a synthetic dataset with hidden confounders and compare the bias and variance of ATE estimates against traditional regression adjustment.

topics.name: Sparse PCA for Gene Expression Data with L1 Regularization
topics.prompt: Let's explore how to implement Sparse PCA on high-dimensional gene expression matrices, incorporating L1 regularization to enforce sparsity in the principal components.

topics.name: t-SNE with Perplexity Optimization on Large-Scale Image Embeddings
topics.prompt: Let's discuss optimizing perplexity parameters for t-SNE when visualizing embeddings from a 200M-image dataset, focusing on computational tricks and convergence criteria.

topics.name: Autoencoder-Based Manifold Learning for 3D Point Cloud Compression
topics.prompt: Let's build an autoencoder architecture tailored for compressing 3D point clouds while preserving geometric structure, including loss functions that penalize reconstruction error and latent space regularization.

topics.name: Diffusion Maps for Anomaly Detection in Network Traffic Logs
topics.prompt: Let's formulate diffusion maps on large-scale network traffic data to identify anomalous patterns, detailing kernel choice, diffusion time selection, and out-of-sample extension methods.

topics.name: Multidimensional Scaling with Graph Laplacian Regularization for Social Network Visualization
topics.prompt: Let's design an MDS pipeline that incorporates graph Laplacian regularization to preserve community structure in social network embeddings, including efficient eigenvalue decomposition strategies.

topics.name: Autoencoder-based Feature Extraction for High-dimensional Genomics Data
topics.prompt: Implement a variational autoencoder to reduce dimensionality of single-cell RNA-seq data while preserving cell-type clusters.

topics.name: Sparse PCA for Real-time Anomaly Detection in Network Traffic
topics.prompt: Design a streaming sparse PCA algorithm that updates component weights online to detect intrusions in high-frequency packet logs.

topics.name: t-SNE Optimization with Barnes-Hut Approximation for Large-Scale Image Embedding
topics.prompt: Develop a GPU-accelerated Barnes-Hut t-SNE implementation that handles 10M image feature vectors and visualizes embeddings in 2D.

topics.name: Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) on Pairwise Distance Matrices from Heterogeneous Sensor Networks
topics.prompt: Create a scalable MDS solver that reconstructs 3D positions of sensors given noisy pairwise distances from a distributed IoT deployment.

topics.name: Kernel PCA with Nyström Extension for Real-time Recommendation Systems
topics.prompt: Implement a Nyström-approximated kernel PCA to compress user-item interaction matrices, enabling fast similarity queries in a streaming recommender.

topics.name: Isomap-Based Manifold Learning for High-Dimensional Genomics Data
topics.prompt: Let's implement Isomap to uncover low-dimensional structure in single-cell RNA-seq datasets and evaluate clustering quality.

topics.name: Autoencoder-Driven Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction for Video Compression
topics.prompt: Let's design a convolutional autoencoder to compress 4K video frames while preserving perceptual quality, and benchmark against traditional codecs.

topics.name: Spectral Embedding on Graph-Structured Social Network Data
topics.prompt: Let's apply Laplacian Eigenmaps to embed users in a social network graph for community detection and recommendation tasks.

topics.name: Random Projection Techniques for Privacy-Preserving Data Sharing
